$comment: A test fixture, not a bundled set: one team's rules, exercising every knob a rule set has (rows read per program and as typed, protected and workflow-only branches, status contexts, repository variables, marker files, a freeze marker, a skip-CI rule, a push variable, a git setting, and guard files).

statusContexts.reason: A review gate goes through `pnpm gate post <pr> <name> <verdict>`, which fingerprints the PR's files and refuses the writer's own branch.
statusContexts.unreadable: This posts a commit status whose context the guard can't read (a variable, a glob, or a body from a file or stdin), and it could be `conveyor/cleared` or a `review/<name>`. Those go through `pnpm conveyor clear` and `pnpm gate post`; the user confirms anything else.

repoVariables.name: RUNNER_POLICY
repoVariables.reason: RUNNER_POLICY decides whether CI may bill hosted runners, so only the repo's owner changes it. Tell them what you need and why.
repoVariables.unreadableName: This variable name is filled in by the shell or a glob, and the guard can't tell it from RUNNER_POLICY or CONVEYOR_ENABLED, which only the owner changes. The user confirms.

markerFiles.name: team-autopilot
markerFiles.reason: This write's target is a pattern or an expansion that could name autopilot mode's marker file, and the guard can't tell what the shell makes of it. Only the user switches autopilot on: use a plain path, or ask them.

freezeMarkers.reason: dev is frozen while the release PR{pr} is open: a push to dev moves its head and cancels its checks. Hold the commit and push it after the merge.

skipCi.reason: [skip ci] is only for docs-only commits on dev; on '{branch}' it leaves required checks pending forever. To land docs on dev from here: a docs-only commit on dev.
skipCi.unreadable: [skip ci] is only for docs-only commits on dev, and the guard couldn't tell which branch this commit is on.

gitConfigAsk.reason: Setting team.prepush decides whether this machine's pre-push hook runs the full check before a push; the user confirms.
